releases.name: English translation
notes: Adds saved movement settings in all three adventures: independent walking and R1 speeds, Hold or Toggle running, and Time or Distance encounter rates.
Restores monster wagers in two-player Colosseum battles, with configurable Local Rules. Prizes are optional; transfers save both Adventure Logs.
Updates the dialogue font and reduces memory use, with fixes for battle loading, scene and NPC graphics, and walking sprites.
Revises monster names, default nicknames, and matching dialogue, including MiniDrak, Slib, and Hellblast. Existing saved nicknames stay unchanged. Includes all earlier translation and gameplay fixes.

releases.name: English translation
notes: Updates community-suggested monster and kingdom names, including CoilBird, Drakeling, Slimeborg, Slabbit, Darck, DeadTree, and BigTrunk.
Clarifies breeding dialogue and corrects the Sky Shield text. Includes the earlier translation and gameplay fixes.
